description: LaCie Mobile Drive Secure is the nexus of portability, capacity, and security. Encased in a sleek Neil Poulton design, each drive is constructed using post-consumer recycled materials. Works with PC and Mac, with password protection that works with Mac OS and Windows. One-click or automatic backup makes file storage simple, and up to 5TB of capacity supplies room for photos, docs, and more.
